meta.title: Poi — make your app look like a product people know
meta.description: A skill for Claude Code. Say "make it Google-ish" and Poi rewrites the screens of your repository in that product's style: color, spacing and wording.

lead: Poi rewrites the screens of your repository,
down to the wording on buttons and errors.
hero.name: The name comes from the Japanese "っぽい" (-ppoi), meaning "-ish".

showcase.caption: The same sample admin app, rewritten by Poi with each company's rules.

product.title: More than a white background and a blue button.
product.statement: The rules are taken from the real screens: color, spacing, and how the company writes.
product.statementMuted: Poi picks a product for each screen: a list like Gmail, a search box like Google Search.
product.label: What Poi does

items.title: Color and spacing
items.body: Colors, sizes and corner radii measured from each product's own pages.

items.title: Wording and tone
items.body: Button labels, errors, empty states and confirmations, rewritten the way that company writes them.

items.title: Behavior stays
items.body: Data fetching, saving and navigation are left as they are. Logos and company names are never copied.

items.title: Every width, both modes
items.body: The layouts your app already has at 1280, 768 and 375px are kept. If your app has a dark mode, it is kept and matched to the product's dark theme.

items.title: Any stack
items.body: The rules are values and example copy, so they fit React or Vue, Tailwind or plain CSS.

product.companies: Gmail, Google Search, Google Cloud console, Slack, GitHub, Amazon and X.

install.title: Get started in three steps.

steps.title: Add the marketplace
steps.body: Run the first command below in your terminal.

steps.title: Ask
steps.body: In Claude Code, open your repository and say "Make it Google-ish." Name a screen to change only that one.

install.note: Poi rewrites your code directly. Commit first, so you can compare the result and undo it.
